Create a 15-second horizontal 16:9 live-action cinematic block with the exact timed shots below. Hard cuts occur only at the listed shot boundaries. Preserve assigned character identities, rigid handmade masks, body proportions and reference costume states. Masks remain inanimate; emotion comes through breathing, posture, hands and timing. Maintain tactile worn materials, restrained exposure and imperfect human camera balance. All performers are adults. Camera movement is physically motivated by the specified action. References anchor design; the written lighting governs illumination. No readable titles or dialogue are generated.
LOCATION AND LIGHT
Kitchen at night. One integrated overhead neutral work lamp lights the foreground counter; distant islands are dimmer. Rounded masonry arches and Iranian relief fragments remain visible beyond modern functional preparation equipment. Metal and cloth are matte, worn and practical.
START STATE AND BLOCKING
Camera on south side of an east-west workbench, looking north. Armayil stands at the far side on screen left, Garmayil on screen right, both facing camera-side across their work. Head Cook approaches behind them from upper screen right. Masks retain original identity; only work garments differ from observer state. Exactly three people are visible.

SHOT 03A | 00s to 05s | 5 seconds
35mm medium-wide from south. Armayil portions ordinary vegetables; Garmayil cleans and arranges serving bowls. Head Cook enters behind Garmayil and stops between the two men, inspecting their hands. Camera advances 20cm with restrained handheld tension. Neither worker turns to acknowledge him.
SHOT 03B | 05s to 09s | 4 seconds
85mm close detail from the same side on Armayil’s hands. He momentarily presses the tool handle too hard, pauses half a beat, then resumes measured cutting. The Head Cook’s sleeve enters at upper right as he reaches toward a finished portion, not toward Armayil’s body.
SHOT 03C | 09s to 15s | 6 seconds
50mm medium three-shot from south. Head Cook examines the finished portion, looks from Armayil to Garmayil, gives a clearly readable approving nod, and taps the workbench once. Both men maintain working posture until he exits screen right. Only then does Garmayil release a shallow breath. Hold their small relief for the final second.
END STATE AND EDIT
Head Cook has exited. Armayil and Garmayil remain in approved kitchen work clothing; these exact garments persist through the rescue night.
SOUND
Blade on vegetables, bowl placement, quiet extraction fan, one bench tap and a restrained exhale.
NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE.
